title: Ensure sshd Ciphers are configured
objective: Audit CIS checkpoint 5.1.4: Ensure sshd Ciphers are configured

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

steps.name: Check if OpenSSH server is installed
steps.function: 1. Check if OpenSSH server is installed using command: `sshd -V 2>&1 || dpkg -l openssh-server 2>/dev/null || rpm -q openssh-server 2>/dev/null`. Expected result: command returns version or package information indicating sshd is present.

steps.name: Check sshd configured ciphers for weak algorithms
steps.function: 2. Check sshd configured ciphers for weak algorithms using command: `sshd -T | grep -Pi -- '^ciphers\h+\"?([^#\n\r]+,)?((3des|blowfish|cast128|aes(128|192|256))-cbc|arcfour(128|256)?|rijndael-cbc@lysator\.liu\.se|chacha20-poly1305@openssh\.com)\b'`. Expected result: no output (no weak ciphers listed).

steps.name: If the previous command returns a line containing chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com, check if system is patched against…
steps.function: 3. If the previous command returns a line containing chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com, check if system is patched against CVE-2023-48795 using command: `sshd -T | grep -i 'chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com' && (grep -i 'CVE-2023-48795' /usr/share/doc/openssh-server/changelog* 2>/dev/null || dpkg -l openssh-server 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^ii' || rpm -q --changelog openssh-server 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'CVE-2023-48795')`. Expected result: patch information or updated version is found.

steps.name: Check that none of the specific weak ciphers (3des-cbc, aes128-cbc, aes192-cbc, aes256-cbc) are present in the sshd…
steps.function: 4. Check that none of the specific weak ciphers (3des-cbc, aes128-cbc, aes192-cbc, aes256-cbc) are present in the sshd configuration using command: `sshd -T | grep -E '^ciphers\s+' | grep -E '(3des-cbc|aes128-cbc|aes192-cbc|aes256-cbc)'`. Expected result: no output.

steps.name: Summarize overall compliance status: PASS if all previous checks pass (no weak ciphers returned, and if…
steps.function: 5. Summarize overall compliance status: PASS if all previous checks pass (no weak ciphers returned, and if chacha20-poly1305 present, patched), SKIP if sshd is not installed, FAIL if any weak cipher is configured or chacha20-poly1305 is present without patch. Expected result: one of PASS, SKIP, or FAIL based on the checks.

computations._cis_status: PASS if audit output contains '** PASS **', FAIL if '** FAIL **', SKIP otherwise

steps.name: Store the final audit result in a variable named 'cis_result' using set_fact. Set cis_result to the overall compliance…
steps.function: 6. Store the final audit result in a variable named 'cis_result' using set_fact. Set cis_result to the overall compliance status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR) derived from the last requirement's status variable.

steps.name: Create a task named 'Generate audit report' using debug msg with EXACTLY this format:
steps.function:
7. Create a task named 'Generate audit report' using debug msg with EXACTLY this format:
AUDIT REPORT — CIS 5.1.4
Reference: CIS Benchmark checkpoint 5.1.4
Then for each requirement: REQUIREMENT NN - {{ req_NN }}:
  With fields: Task, Command, Exit code, Data, Status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR), Details.
End with OVERALL COMPLIANCE: section containing Result: {{{ cis_result }}}

steps.name: Emit compliance result
steps.function: Output the overall compliance status to the caller.

steps.function: Reached via rescue block on any unexpected task failure.

compliance_constraints: Use failed_when: false on all audit tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all checks complete and report status
If the audit targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, report SKIP for all checks.
This is an AUDIT playbook — it MUST NOT make any changes to the system. All tasks must be read-only (shell commands, stat, slurp, command with check-only flags, etc.).
reference_procedure:
Run the following command to verify none of the "weak" ciphers are being used:
# sshd -T | grep -Pi --
'^ciphers\h+\"?([^#\n\r]+,)?((3des|blowfish|cast128|aes(128|192|256))- cbc|arcfour(128|256)?|rijndael-cbc@lysator\.liu\.se|chacha20- poly1305@openssh\.com)\b'
- IF - a line is returned, review the list of ciphers. If the line includes chacha20- poly1305@openssh.com, review CVE-2023-48795 and verify the system has been patched. No ciphers in the list below should be returned as they're considered "weak":
3des-cbc
aes128-cbc
aes192-cbc
aes256-cbc
